items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Wayne was interviewed in New York City on January 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Wayne was interviewed in New York City on January 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Manhattan for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have veteran trombonist Wayne Andre with me.
